articles.title: India news: Army says 'Pakistani terrorist' killed in Kashmir
articles.summary: The Indian Army confirmed the killing of a 'Pakistani terrorist' during an overnight military operation in Indian-administered Kashmir. This incident marks the latest in a series of counter-terrorism efforts in the highly militarized region, underscoring ongoing security challenges and military vigilance. It highlights India's proactive stance against cross-border infiltration and maintaining national security in the sensitive area.

articles.title: Saudi air defences intercept, destroy 10 hostile drones over Riyadh and eastern territories
articles.summary: The Saudi Ministry of Defence announced the interception and destruction of 10 drones targeting its Riyadh and eastern regions. This successful air defence operation marks a significant escalation in aerial activity, highlighting persistent security threats in the area and the critical role of robust air defence capabilities against such challenges.

articles.title: Two weeks into war with Iran, Trump has been knocked back on his political heels
articles.summary: Following US and Israeli strikes on Iran two weeks ago, President Donald Trump has faced increasing political pressure and agitation regarding news coverage. This situation highlights the domestic political ramifications for the US President stemming from international military engagements and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, impacting his political standing.

articles.title: Strait of Hormuz watch: How Navy warships are protecting India-bound ships amid rising gulf tensions
articles.summary: Indian Navy warships, operating under Operation Sankalp in the Gulf region, are maintaining constant surveillance on India-bound cargo vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz. This deployment ensures the security of vital maritime trade routes, safeguarding India's economic interests and demonstrating its commitment to protecting merchant shipping in critical international waters amidst regional tensions.

articles.title: Taiwan says large-scale Chinese military flights return after unusual absence
articles.summary: Taiwan reported the return of significant Chinese air force activities around the island on Sunday, ending an unexplained two-week lull. This resumption escalates concerns regarding cross-strait tensions and China's persistent military presence near Taiwan. Such maneuvers are crucial for SSB aspirants to understand regional security dynamics and potential geopolitical flashpoints.

articles.title: Russian air defences down 65 drones headed for Moscow, mayor says
articles.summary: Russian air defence units reportedly downed 65 Ukrainian drones targeting Moscow on Saturday, as stated by Mayor Sergei Sobyanin. This incident highlights the ongoing aerial conflict and Ukraine's continued use of drone attacks on Russian territory, demonstrating the persistent intensity of the conflict and the challenges in defending major urban centers against such threats.
